text:
aj: fyi security-scan popped CVE-2026-XXXX in our python base layer during the nightly SBOM run. looks exploit-y for container runtime. need a plan for base-image rebuild + signer rotation :warning:

maria: ack. do we have a minimal repro? can we triage if it's in the layer we control or a 3rd-party package? :eyes:

aj: repro attached to the alert, snippet shows vulnerable symbol in /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6. scanning further now. if it's our layer, we should do a fast rebase and push signed canary images to staging.

sarah: agree. two parallel tracks: 1) emergency base rebuild with mitigations (strip debug, updated glibc pkg), 2) rotate ephemeral signer keys and open a short KMS audit window so we can trace who signs what. security wants audit logs shipped to secure bucket during the window.

kevin: ops question — can we do ephemeral signer keys with current KMS policy? last time we had trouble with ttl bindings.

maria: quick answer: yes, but we need a one-off RBAC grant for the "image-canary-operator" SA to use kms:Encrypt/decrypt/Sign for the new key. can we limit to a 6h TTL?

devin: we can create a short-lived IAM binding via terraform runbook. proposing: create key, grant iam binding to "sa:image-canary-operator@redwood", set expiration 6h, run rebuild pipeline, revoke. I can own the TF changes.

aj: sounds good. outline of steps: 
- create KMS key with labeled purpose = "ephemeral-image-signer-YYYYMMDD"
- apply RBAC binding to canary SA (6h)
- trigger base rebuild pipeline to produce redwood/base:canary-YYYYMMDD
- sign image with ephemeral key, push to staging registry
- run vuln tests + canary rollout to small pool
- revoke binding, rotate to permanent key if ok

sarah: add: enable audit log shipping for KMS and registry operations to s3://security-audit-YYYYMM. Set lifecycle to 365d. Make sure logs include signer principal and key id.

kevin: ops-bot queueing a preflight job: 
```
./ci pipeline run --job rebuild-base --image-tag canary-20260305 --sign-with ephemeral-key
```

ops-bot: preflight check OK: registry quotas, available GPU builders, and TF workspace locks. :white_check_mark:

qa-bot: will run regression suites and fuzz harness on canary once image pushed. ETA ~45m after push.

maria: RBAC nit: audit team needs to be able to read KMS audit logs, but not manage keys. create a role "kms-audit-reader" with only get/list logs.

devin: terraform plan ready, posting snippet: 
```hcl
resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "ephemeral_signer" {
  name     = "ephemeral-signer-20260305"
  purpose  = "ASYMMETRIC_SIGN"
  rotation_period = "0s" # manual rotate
}
resource "google_project_iam_member" "canary_sa_bind" {
  role   = "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier"
  member = "serviceAccount:image-canary-operator@redwood"
  condition {
    title       = "short-lived"
    expression  = "request.time < timestamp(\"2026-03-05T09:00:00Z\")"
  }
}
```

aj: nice. two additional asks: 1) snapshot build logs to S3 path with CVE tag, 2) make sure the signing token is never printed in build logs.

sarah: I'll add a post-deploy checklist for incident records and coordinate security advisory text if we need to notify customers. also open a ticket for legal/compliance for any regulated customers if exploitability confirmed.

kevin: ops-bot kicked off the pipeline: build started at 3305002502. linking console: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/9812

maria: can everyone with rights please monitor the canary for 2h after push. if no regressions, we'll promote and rotate keys to long-lived signer after completing audit.

aj: if exploit confirmed or any runtime crashes, we abort and rollback to previous signed image. logging: collect core dumps to ephemeral secure bucket and tag in incident ticket.

devin: pushed TF apply at 3305002560, ephemeral key created, binding applied. leaving key id in ops channel (restricted).

ops-bot: build succeeded, image pushed redwood/base:canary-20260305 at 3305002598. signing step completed with ephemeral key id projects/.../cryptoKeys/ephemeral-signer-20260305/cryptoKeyVersions/1

qa-bot: regression run passed initial smoke; fuzzing in progress.

sarah: audit logs confirmed shipping — KMS sign events show the canary SA principal. security will export the subset to the incident ticket under //incidents/2026-03-05-002.

kevin: after 2h monitoring with no issues, plan is to: revoke ephemeral binding, rotate main signer to include patched image, and rebuild release channel images. scheduled window 2026-03-05T11:30Z.

aj: thanks all. labeling this thread: image-hardening + kms-ephemeral-rotation. owner: devin for TF + kevin for ops rollout + sarah for audit/tracker. closing loop once release images promoted. :lock:

maria: pinging infra to please posture package updates for base layer so we don't reintroduce the same lib. i'll file follow-up PR.

kevin: noted. will coordinate with infra tomorrow morning for a longer-term patch cadence.

aj: great work team.
